{{Quote|One day soon the Selkath will pay for the indignities they have inflicted on the Sith!|The Sith diplomat, speaking to Revan after his hearing had ended|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] worked as a '''Sith diplomat''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] in [[3956 BBY]]. The [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] represented a group of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the [[Ahto High Court]] during a hearing that was the result of a brawl between his clients and a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic soldier|soldiers]]. Both sides were found to be at fault and were fined by the [[Ahto City Civil Authority]]. [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], witnessed the hearing while he was visiting the planet.

==Biography==
{{Quote|They say everyone on Manaan is equal. But it seems the Republic is a little more equal than the Sith. Neutrality? Ha! That's a laugh!|The Sith diplomat, expressing his opinion of the Selkath's laws|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] was stationed on the [[Water/Legends|water]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]<ref name="KOTOR" /> in [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> He was the representative of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] during a hearing in the [[Ahto High Court]] that was the result of a brawl between his clients and a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic soldier|soldiers]]. The neutrality laws of Manaan meant that open aggression between the warring sides was illegal on the planet, and so they were brought to trial for the incident. As the diplomat argued that his soldiers should not be punished for winning a fair fight, [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], entered the court and witnessed the hearing. The Republic [[Unidentified Republic diplomat|representative]] rebuked this claim, stating six against three was hardly a fair fight. The Republic agent informed the court that his men had been goaded into the fight, but the [[Judge/Legends|judges]] decreed that words were not sufficient provocation, and the [[Ahto City Civil Authority]] fined both the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the incident.<ref name="KOTOR" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Revan spoke with the diplomat at the conclusion of the trial, after which the diplomat complained about the treatment of the Sith on Manaan.<ref name="KOTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
The diplomat believed that Sith victory in the war was inevitable and that Manaan's native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]], should abandon their neutrality and align with the Sith, or they might be forced to do so in the future. He also believed that the Selkath, while claiming neutrality on the surface, were actually biased against the Sith. He was completely and utterly loyal to [[Darth Malak]]'s Sith Empire.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith diplomat appears in the [[Roleplaying game|RPG]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2003]], when the player visits Manaan and enters the Selkath courtroom in Ahto City for the first [[Time/Legends|time]]. It is possible to speak to him after the scene has concluded, during which he spouts several pro-Sith phrases to the player, like the quotes presented in this article. It is also possible for the player to never encounter this character, as there is no required reason to enter the courtroom before the [[raid on the Sith Embassy]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

This diplomat and [[Grann (commander)|Grann]] have the same character model in the video game,<ref name="KOTOR" /> as well as both being voiced by the same voice actor, [[Cam Clarke]].{{Fact}} They are both given the generic name of "Sith Diplomat" as well; however, they are separate characters.<ref name="KOTOR" />
